correctness.rationale: PASS for repairs/5/RESULT.md and repairs/5/SLOGAN.txt. The frozen exact ranking is correct, but the prose and slogan misidentify grouping as what minimizes turnover: in the strict case both 1234 and 1243 have adjacent lower labels and adjacent higher labels, yet 1234 is strictly intermediate. The corrected files identify the minimizing class by its cross-group adjacencies and retain the exact ranking. The period map contracts by product(u_i) in (0,1), so it has a unique periodic state; conservation equates expected colonization and extinction counts, and total activity is twice the extinction count. In the transformed clock p'=q−p, the integrated extinction intensity is baseline plus the covariance deficit ∫q(q−p). The causal exponential convolution and periodic translation give the squared-difference energy, unchanged by reflecting q; strict positivity for nonconstant q follows by integrating the lag over a whole period, where the unweighted integral equals 2L times the integrated variance density. For the four-block identities, in (1−product(u_i)) times the excess, the coefficient for q_i q_j is −(1−u_i)(1−u_j) times the sum of products on the two open arcs. With remaining labels a,b, adjacency changes this arc sum from u_a+u_b to 1+u_a u_b, a difference of (1−u_a)(1−u_b). The exchanged exclusive adjacent pairs then give exactly the two factored differences; diagonal terms are order-independent. The three dihedral classes, gap signs, equal-occupancy limits and worked example follow. The supplied rational and optional symbolic scripts were inspected, not executed; the former samples finitely, the latter expands the two identities, and neither checks the misleading grouping statement. The repaired text contains an independent all-duration calculation.
